text:
Aisha: Quick question 1 can we add a stretch slot for one "high-touch" partner who wants co-design time? Need decision before outreach.
Sam: What's the ask for high-touch? More engineering hours + weekly design reviews?
Tara: From comms POV it helps with testimonials and detailed case studies. Worth it if partner commits to public story.
Neil: ML caveat: high-touch may require model change access (weights/config) which we normally disallow for pilots. Could offer tuning knobs instead.
Priya: Legal: public case studies require a separate consent clause. Also, extra eng hours mean we should convert to a paid engagement or limit to 2 partners max.
Aisha: Proposal: 1 stretch slot, 6 hours/week eng support, weekly 1-hour co-design session, must allow anonymized case study or signed quote.
Sam: Scoring-wise I can prioritize any candidate with clear ROI metrics. If they accept the case study ask, bump them +2 in ranking.
Tara: Outreach tweak: call it "co-design partner" in the invite and note limited availability.
CS-bot: (automated) pilot playbook link: https://redwood.example/pilot-playbook
Priya: Also add clause: partner can opt out of public case study but then we revert to standard slot with no extra support.
Neil: Fine as long as we control model-level changes. We'll provide tuning and feature-priority commits, not model code.
Aisha: OK owners: Sam to include stretch-bump in rubric, Priya to draft case-study consent, Josh will confirm capacity for extra support (tagging infra in separate thread). If no objections by EOD we add the stretch slot to outreach copy.
Sam: fine by me :thumbsup:
Tara: good from comms :+1:
Priya: legal good
Neil: ML good
Aisha: thanks all, will update invite doc and post final.
